summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for the Petrol Pump Daily Account Management App (FuelLedger India). Covers fuel rate tracking, multi-machine meter calculations, digital payment ledgers (Paytm, UPI, Card), dual-mode testing deductions, an Indian currency note counter, cash reconciliation (expected vs actual), historical record browsing, PDF/printable reporting, bilingual English/Hindi support, and offline backup/restore.
